settings.title: About Us
settings.main_content: One true pairing believes in empowering individuality , exclusivity and personal style as a means of self expression . Textures & colours evoke emotions that can range from joy to total inspiration and originality . It is behind these one of a kind pieces with versatile materials and carefree aesthetics where the true story of one true pairing begins . We value thoughtful details and to us colours , textures and authenticity make a personal style statement an influential voice on identity ,belonging and individualism. One true pairing's ideology embodies connecting every individual to their true pairing of distinctive expressions .
